Paperlark Terms of Use

Effective October 9, 2026 · Last updated October 9, 2026

In plain English: your use of Paperlark is governed by Apple's standard app license, plus the extra terms below. Text recognition, extracted details, summaries and automatic redaction can make mistakes, so check anything important before you rely on it or share it. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel, and a free trial turns into a paid subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.

Apple's Standard EULA

Paperlark is licensed to you, not sold, under Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (the "Standard EULA"). The Standard EULA, including its sections on the scope of the license, consent to use of data, termination, warranty disclaimers, limitation of liability, export rules and governing law, applies to Paperlark. These Terms of Use add app-specific terms. If these terms and the Standard EULA conflict, the Standard EULA controls, except where these terms give you more rights. We (the developer of Paperlark), not Apple, are responsible for Paperlark and its support. Apple is a third-party beneficiary of the Standard EULA and may enforce it.

By downloading or using Paperlark you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the app. Our Privacy Policy explains how data is handled.

Accuracy of text, details and summaries

  • Recognized text, automatic names and folders, document types, and extracted details such as vendors, dates, amounts and due dates are produced automatically on your device and can be wrong or incomplete.
  • AI summaries and answers to questions about a document are generated on your device, with Apple's on-device Foundation Models where available. Nobody reviews them, and they can miss or misstate information.
  • Paperlark is a scanning and organizing tool. It does not give legal, tax, financial or medical advice. Always check the original document before you pay a bill, file taxes, sign or make a decision, and don't rely only on due-date reminders.

Redaction and password protection

  • Smart redaction detects common kinds of personal information automatically and can miss some. You are responsible for reviewing a redacted copy before you share it. The redacted copy has the covered areas burned into its images and the covered text removed from its text layer; your original document in Paperlark is not changed.
  • Password-protected PDFs use Apple's standard PDF encryption. How well a password protects a file depends on the password you choose. We cannot recover a forgotten password.

Signatures

Paperlark lets you place your own drawn signature or initials on documents. You are responsible for signing only documents you are entitled to sign, and for checking whether an electronic signature is acceptable for a particular document where you live. Paperlark does not verify identity and is not a certified electronic-signature or notary service.

Using Paperlark

Paperlark is not directed at children. If you are under the age of majority where you live, use it with the permission of a parent or guardian, who also agrees to these terms for purchases. Features may differ between versions and devices (for example, on-device AI needs a supported iPhone with Apple Intelligence) and may change as we improve the app.

Free version and ads

Scanning, text recognition, search and export are free, with no watermark. The free version shows ads served by third-party ad networks through AppLovin MAX: banners only on the documents library list, and at most one full-screen ad per session after a completed export or share, never after your first export. Ads never appear in the camera and scanning screens, the editor, signing, redaction, the document assistant, onboarding or the Pro screen. We are not responsible for the content of third-party ads or the websites or apps they link to, although we ask our ad partners to block gambling, dating and mature ads where their controls allow it. Rewarded ads may unlock a small bonus described in the app (such as a one-time Pro export); rewards have no cash value, cannot be transferred and may change.

Paperlark Pro: subscriptions, free trial and lifetime purchase

The free version of Paperlark includes ads and the features described in the app as free. Paperlark Pro unlocks the Pro features and removes ads. Pro is available as:

  • An auto-renewing subscription (yearly, and any other period offered in the app). The yearly plan may include a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, as an Apple introductory offer.
  • A lifetime purchase: a one-time, non-consumable purchase. No renewals.

The price, billing period and trial length are shown in the app before you confirm and in Apple's purchase sheet. Prices vary by country and may include taxes.

How billing works

  • Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. If you start a free trial, you are not charged during the trial; your Apple ID is charged the subscription price when the trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.
  • Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends, at the then-current price.
  • You can manage or cancel a subscription at any time in iOS Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions, or from the "Manage subscription" option in the app's Settings. Cancelling stops future renewals; you keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for. If you cancel during a free trial, Apple may end your access to Pro right away.
  • Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription or the lifetime purchase.
  • If a price increases, Apple notifies you in advance and, where required, asks for your consent before renewing at the new price.
  • If you have a subscription and later buy the lifetime purchase, cancel the subscription in Settings so you are not charged twice. The app reminds you.
  • Purchases are shareable with up to five other family members through Apple's Family Sharing, where the app says so.

Refunds and restores

All payments are processed by Apple. We cannot see or issue refunds; request one from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. Apple's refund decisions and your statutory rights (for example, EU/UK withdrawal rights for digital content) are handled by Apple under its terms. Use "Restore Purchases" in the app to get Pro back on a new device signed in to the same Apple ID.

For Paperlark, Pro is offered as a yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, and as a one-time lifetime purchase that is shareable through Family Sharing. The current price in your currency is shown in the app and in Apple's purchase sheet before you confirm.

Your documents

Your documents stay on your device; this version does not sync to iCloud. You are responsible for the documents you scan, import and share, for keeping your device, Apple ID and exported files secure, and for keeping backups. We cannot recover documents you delete or lose because we never have a copy. Don't rely on Paperlark as the only copy of an original you are legally required to keep.

Acceptable use

Don't use Paperlark to break the law or anyone else's rights, including by forging signatures, altering documents to deceive anyone, or copying documents you have no right to copy; don't try to reverse-engineer, tamper with or bypass the app's purchase checks or ad systems, except where the law allows this despite this restriction; and don't use automated means to generate fake ad impressions or rewards.

Disclaimers and liability

Paperlark is provided "as is" and "as available", as described in the Standard EULA. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for decisions you make based on recognized text, extracted details or summaries, for information that automatic redaction did not cover, for missed notifications or reminders, or for the loss of documents stored on your device, and our total liability is limited as described in the Standard EULA. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or rights you have under consumer law in your country that cannot be waived.

Changes

We may update these terms, for example when we add features. We will change the date at the top and, for significant changes, tell you in the app. Continuing to use Paperlark after a change means you accept the updated terms. Changes never apply retroactively to purchases you already made.
